whatIs.title: What is wind chill
items: Wind strips heat from the body faster, so it feels colder than the thermometer says. Winter wind chill puts a number on that.
KMA calculates it only at 10°C or below with wind of 1.3 m/s or more, for the winter season from October to April.
Formula: 13.12 + 0.6215T − 11.37V^0.16 + 0.3965V^0.16T, with T in °C and V the 10-minute mean wind in km/h (1 m/s = 3.6 km/h).

coldWave.title: Cold wave alert criteria
items: Advisory: from October to April, when the morning low is expected to drop 10°C or more from the previous day to 3°C or below and 3°C under normal, or stay at −12°C or below for two days or more.
Warning: a drop of 15°C or more to 3°C or below and 3°C under normal, or −15°C or below for two days or more.
Alerts are also issued when sudden cold is expected to cause serious damage. The 'Cold wave' column here uses forecast temperatures only and may differ from official alerts.

prevent.title: Preventing cold illness
items: Check wind chill before going out and cut outdoor activity on cold days.
Wear thin layers and keep warm with a hat, gloves, scarf and mask.
Change out of wet clothes or shoes right away.
If you suspect hypothermia (body temperature 35°C or below), call 119. Don't rub frostbitten skin or put it straight into hot water.

items.a: Using KMA's winter formula (13.12 + 0.6215T − 11.37V^0.16 + 0.3965V^0.16T) with temperature T in °C and wind V in km/h. At −5°C with 5 m/s wind it feels like about −11°C.
KMA doesn't calculate wind chill when wind is 1.3 m/s or less or the temperature is above 10°C; it's treated as the air temperature.
−10°C or above: watch; −25 to −10°C: caution; −45 to −25°C: warning; below −45°C: danger (KMA open data portal).

items.q: What are the cold wave alert criteria?
items.a: An advisory when the morning low is expected at −12°C or below for two days or more, a warning at −15°C for two days. Also when it drops 10°C (warning 15°C) or more to 3°C or below and 3°C under normal.

items.q: Where does the forecast come from?
items.a: Hourly temperature and 10 m wind from MET Norway, fetched every 3 hours and run through the KMA formula. Numbers can differ slightly from KMA's own forecast.

items.q: Is summer 'feels like' the same formula?
items.a: No. Summer (May–September) uses a different formula based on temperature and humidity. This tool covers winter wind chill only.
